sn46.43:1.1: “Bhikkhus, I will teach you the path crushing the army of Māra.
sn46.43:1.3: “And what, bhikkhus, is the path crushing the army of Māra?
sn46.43:1.5: It is the seven factors of enlightenment.
sn46.43:1.7: The enlightenment factor of mindfulness … the enlightenment factor of equanimity.
sn46.43:1.8: This is the path crushing the army of Māra.”
